name: calendar
title: Calendar
summary: Events as stars, read only. Needs your own private ICS link: off and unconnected until you enter it yourself.

settings.help: A person id, or household for a calendar the whole family shares.

settings.prompt: How many days back to show
How many days ahead to show
At most how often to read the calendar, in seconds
settings.help: 300 to 86400. It is read at map rebuilds; a failed read waits longer each time, up to six hours.

secrets.prompt: Paste your calendar's private ICS link
secrets.help: Its secret iCal address, https or webcal. Anyone holding it can read the calendar. It is never shown back or written to rhythm.yaml.

secrets.prompt: A second calendar's private ICS link
A third calendar's private ICS link
